formulas.ascii: For polygon f, L[f]=sum_s insideLength[s,f], W[f]=sum_s pathWeight[s]*insideLength[s,f], N[f]=sum_s 1[insideLength[s,f]>0]. Inside length sums pieces between ring crossings whose midpoint passes even-odd containment. Planar pieces measure (t1-t0)*length(b-a); longitude/latitude pieces measure sphere radius times geodesicCentralAngle between their degree-linear endpoints. Weights are per path, repeated for each segment. Capacity overflow can undercount.
